name: R4 stages D and F: finite-grid paths and fixed-order witness accumulation
stage_D_groups: All30 original groups: datasets MNIST/Fashion-MNIST, seeds11/22/33/44/55, K50/100/200; original16widths x6penalties each.
stage_D_scores: Reconstruct normalized query class scores from archived weights. Signed margin = maximum competing score minus nearest-prototype-label score. Strict numerical states: +1 if margin>1e-10*(1+abs(competing)+abs(nearest)); -1 if margin<negative guard;0 otherwise. Invalid zero-penalty rank condition gets state2. Store all margins, guards, states, predictions and parameter grids.
stage_D_detection: First sampled strict disagreement index; left-censored if firstpenalty0 alreadydisagrees; no-detection/right-censored if no sampled strict disagreement. Store adjacent strict +/- transition masks and transitions between consecutive nonzero valid states. Report any sampled return to strict agreement after disagreement. Every interval is a sampled bracket; no unique/earliest continuous crossing is inferred.
stage_D_bounds: Compare only K100 and only exact R3 bound reference widths (seven upperwidths); other9widths missing, and all K50/K200 missing B. Store finite/no-competing-limit/missingbound separately. Record B/raw and B/operator, firstdisagreement penalty and B/firstpositive penalty when defined. Recover archived R3 originalfinite masks over every requestedregion.
stage_F_groups: Same10 K100groups and original7 upperwidths x floors0,1,100 as R3. F0 original96 readouts; F1 adds ALL archived frontier and localtail readouts; L0 original7width cumulative limiting mask; Lplus adds dense67width limiting witnesses. No new fits.
stage_F_order: For each requestedregion, filter includedwidths/penalties first. Group widths equal within rtol1e-13/atol0 and sort ascending. Within eachwidth sort penalty increasing then sourcepriority original,frontier,local_tail and archiveindex. Interleave round-robin: first eligible penalty at every width ascending, then second eligible penalty at every width ascending,etc. This is fixed before extraction, not selected by outcomes.
stage_F_counts: At eachprobe store cumulativefinite exclusions, marginalnew, overlap and unique withL0/Lplus; also cumulative unions assisted byL0/Lplus. Record earliestprefix capturing95% and100%ofL0 cases and earliestprefix recovering finalfinite/combined mask. Last metrics are retrospective completeness diagnostics, not prospective stopping guarantees.
stage_F_cost: Actual new modelsolves=0. Replay probe count is numberof archived readoutchecks; hypothetical solve counts are labeled operationcounts only. Record analysis elapsed time after one-group pilot, singlethread BLAS; no wallclock speedupcomparison or savedcompute claim.
inputs: R3 frozen numerical outputs and originalimmutable evidence/; file hashes in executionreceipt.
aggregation: Five seedwise values, mean and sampleSD; commonqueryIDs reused acrossseeds. Query-width and query-seed totals are audit counts, not statistical sample sizes.
stop: Exhaust specified stored grids once, retain zero and null outcomes, no newtraining or continuouspath solver.
